Expected regex pattern 'store\.steampowered\.com/dlc/570' correctly targets the Dota 2 DLC listing page (App ID 570 on Steam), which is exactly what the instruction requires.
The evaluator is negative-control resistant: the initial state opens 'https://store.steampowered.com' which does not contain '/dlc/570', so the evaluator correctly fails for the do-nothing baseline.
Instruction coverage is complete: the single requirement is to navigate to the DLC listing page, and the evaluator checks exactly that via URL pattern matching.
